description: User read a sentence or passage during reading. This event is the authoritative source for sourceId — all word.saved and morpheme.encountered events reference back to this record via sourceId.

sourceId.description: Globally unique identifier for this sentence read event. Authoritative sourceId used by downstream word.saved and morpheme.encountered events. Format: sha256(sentenceText + userDid + readAt) or application-assigned UUID.

content.description: Content-addressed reference (contentHash of the normalized sentence) that replaces the removed surface `sentence` field. Full sentence text must NEVER appear on a public firehose record (see RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S5); downstream difficulty ratings join by this one-way hash. Recommended on every record so ratings can key on the hash.

privateRecordRef.description: Optional opaque pointer to the server-only Tier B parse/sentence-analysis record (refType sentenceAnalysis/parseCache) that holds the full surface text and parse tiers. Server-resolvable only; carries no text itself.

wordCount.description: Number of words (eojeol) in the sentence
